prefab.name: ownCloud Infinite Scale
prefab.description: ownCloud file sync and sharing (oCIS), without a separate database.

admin_password.help: Login: admin. Generated at deployment and applied at the first start only: change it in ownCloud afterwards.
admin_password.label: Administrator password

trust_any_certificate.help: oCIS calls its own address and checks its certificate. Only for a development node whose proxy issues an internal certificate; leave off in production.
trust_any_certificate.label: Trust any certificate of the site

config.description: oCIS configuration and internal secrets, generated at installation. Keep it: the data depends on it.
